reviews.title: Impossible to find out how to cancel
reviews.text: I read a story. It was subpar at best. Now I try to cancel my subscription and it’s impossible. Buyer beware!!

reviews.title: Stolen money
reviews.text: I just made a $14 something payment with my Apple account and then was promoted to login so I logged in with my Apple account, upon which all my just purchased coins disappeared. Why take my money and then hide the coins from the very account used to purchase them??? How fraudulent. Definitely deserves a 1 star rating. 0 if it was possible!

reviews.title: Won’t stop auto charging
reviews.text:
Signed up for one week. Cancelled the subscription and they are continuing to try to auto charge my card. 
There is no longer a place for me to cancel and no customer support. Don’t do it unless you want to replace your card.
Would give negative stars if possible.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: Do not purchase anything from this app. I’ve been charged twice since I canceled my account subscription. So I took my cards off Apple so they couldn’t charge me anymore and now I can’t do anything on my Apple account because they’re saying I owe them money for this subscription that I didn’t ask for. If you give them your info, they will never stop charging you.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I hate that I cannot use my card and purchase coins separately anymore. It’s only allowing in app purchases through Apple Pay. This has just ruined this app for me

reviews.title: Removing Features Every Update
reviews.text: They used to have a feature where you can download episodes, wow they still have that feature but now you can’t download episodes if they have an animation tied to that episode. Before you used to be able to, but not only did they get rid of that feature they also made it to where if you wanna listen to the episode with full subtitles on the screen you have to go to the download section instead of in your favorites like you normally did. I’ve asked them why they remove this feature and it keeps saying you’ll have to just deal with it, but I don’t care about the animation. Especially if that’s the only story out there that has the animated version tied to the episodes. It’s not fair that they keep taking away features and then wanting us to buy other versions of the audiobooks that either have different voice actors and then make us have to spend more coins which isn’t fair.

reviews.title: Not worth it!
reviews.text: You have to do the whole coin buying thing to unlock chapters or wait for the bonus. If you pay for the subscription it doesn’t include everything. A lot of the audio stories are 100 plus chapters and then it just ends, no closing to the story it just leaves you on a cliffhanger and you don’t know if or when they will finish.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Way too pricey and even if you have the patience to earn the coins to unlock chapters that will end when those same chapters lock again without notice! It’s just a scam!

reviews.title: Good narrators-But very expensive.
reviews.text: The stories are mediocre, about what you would find on your standard fanfiction writing website- they are interesting enough, but not worth the price in my opinion. By the time I got to the end of the book that brought me to the app, I spent $30 on it, and it was only 15hrs long. Not the worst- but considering that audible chargers $22 for 2 credits(2books) and the books there are often longer, with some books even being free, I will not continue using this app. The narrators were good, but not good enough for the price. The options to get free coins are often time consuming and the reward is minuscule. This app would be better if you could pay per book. I found it frustrating that I kept paying $10 for 1k coins every few chapters, with no information how many coins I would need until I was close to the end of the book.

reviews.title: Coins and bonuses
reviews.text: There have been multiple time where chapters have been purchased without my approval, spending almost well over 1000 coins/bonuses. I had gone in to make sure that auto-unlock was not on and it was not. This has happened at least 5 different times and when I tried to contact them about the most recent event they said that it was not refundable because it wasn’t a problem on their end even though it was. When I reached out to them for the 5th time they finally admitted to there being a completely separate area called “Voice Prompt Auto-Unlock” and allows new chapters to be unlocked using coins even though auto-unlock is turn off for all of the books.
